item.perfectmobfarmrevived.mob_slot_upgr: Adds a second mob shard slot to a mob farm.
item.perfectmobfarmrevived.speed_upgrade: Valid for Iron, Gold, Diamond and Emerald farms. Each one lowers the cooldown by %s%%.
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.farm.container: Place a container (chest, hopper...) directly below the farm; the loot is generated into it.
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.farm.energy: Needs energy to work: it uses %s FE/t and holds up to %s FE
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.farm.lever: Place a lever on the farm: it only works while the lever is ON
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.farm.mob_slot_: Accepts a Mob Slot Upgrade (second shard)
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.farm.stats: Generates loot every %s seconds with Looting %s.
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.farm.use: Right click the farm to open it and insert a completed Mob Shard.
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.shard.durabili: Loses 1 durability each time the farm generates loot (%s uses). It only becomes unbreakable if enabled in the config.
Unbreakable by default (can be changed in the config).
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.shard.link: Right click a mob with the shard to link it to that mob type, then kill %s mobs of that type with the shard in your inventory to complete it.
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.shard.link.ins: Right click a mob with the shard to link it to that mob type. That is enough to complete it.
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.shard.use: Put a completed shard in a Mob Farm to generate the loot of the linked mob.
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.upgrade.instal: Place it in the upgrade slot of the mob farm screen.
jei.perfectmobfarmrevived.upgrade.mob_sl: It can not be taken out while the second shard slot holds a shard.
